Non-Structural Panel Removal, Refit and Alignment

ksbs.description: Motor vehicle chassis and body alignment, measurement and geometry implications.
Body types, panel identification, safety systems, materials and alternative-fuel considerations.
Body-panel repair tools, equipment and devices.
Removal, repair and replacement of panels and associated parts.
Interpretation of technical data, repair methods and joining/replacement requirements.
Quality control and implications of poor-quality repair.
Panel joining processes including welding, brazing, riveting and bonding.
Health, safety, environmental and bodyshop compliance.
Commercial productivity, accuracy, cycle time and impact of rework.
Prepare the job safely, including work area, panel, vehicle and measurement setup.
Identify construction materials and suitable repair/joining techniques.
Interpret technical data, methods, measurements and alignment requirements.
Select and apply the correct joining technology.
Remove, repair and replace panels/components safely and efficiently.
Identify, select and operate panel-repair tools and equipment.
Identify and communicate supplementary damage, quality issues and repair progress.
Detect and rectify or escalate safety-critical structural faults.
Work safely and efficiently to procedures.
Work effectively with others, take responsibility and communicate progress or delay.
Seek learning about the wider collision-repair business.
Show commitment to customer service and deadlines.
Take responsibility for personal/professional development and emerging technology.
Anticipate problems, apply controls and address root causes.
Communicate effectively with customers and colleagues.
